svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 280 x 280 mm; file the edges and round the corners.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Centre hole 62 mm for the generator shaft and spigot (check the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: generator: the hole must clear its spigot by 1 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Post holes 11 mm at 125 mm each way from the centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generator screw holes 6.6 mm on a 176 mm circle at 45 deg (the model's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: figure; copy the circle and angle from the generator bought).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the centre from the diagonals so the shaft lines up with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: sits on the four posts, nuts on top; generator on top, four M6

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws from below; the guard stops 1 mm under it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the plate sits on all four posts without rocking.
